overview: The Medford Historical Commission held public hearings for 15 Maple Park Avenue and 71 Mystic Avenue, determining in both cases that the properties were not preferably preserved and allowing demolition plans to proceed.

items.title: 15 Maple Park Avenue Preferably Preserved Hearing
items.summary: Following comments from neighbors concerned about the safety and condition of the vacant Hegner Center, the Commission voted against preferably preserved status, allowing the demolition to proceed with a recommendation to salvage the builder's plaques.

items.title: 71 Mystic Avenue Preferably Preserved Hearing
items.summary: After reviewing interior photos and considering its heavily altered state, the Commission voted against preferably preserved status for the property, allowing the applicant to move forward with plans to construct a self-storage facility.

items.title: 73 Surry Street Hearing Tabling
items.summary: The public hearing was tabled to the October 19th meeting because the property owner was unable to publish the legal advertisement in time.

items.title: 141 Grant Street Demolition Application
items.summary: The Commission voted to accept a demolition application for the property, scheduling a historical significance determination for the next meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Commission approved the meeting minutes from September 14, 2026.
